purpose: Define the one action that places a room: drop the Blueprint, choose the room type, and get a shell, its dressing surfaces, its fill volume and its gameplay carrier - with the shell's metrics frozen so a second instance is identical to the first.

authority.decision: the carrier is a FIXED CHILD of the kit - Jev, 2026-10-22, 3/3 samples, mean distribution A .607 / B .253 / C .087 / D .053

meter.note: the standard doorway system between room types (case study BS-04: a shared portal system is what makes different kits combinable without bespoke geometry)

inputs.name: RoomType
inputs.note: the one property that chooses the room

inputs.name: Seed
inputs.note: the room's deterministic seed; the same seed and type must reproduce the same room

inputs.name: FillDensityScale
inputs.note: scales the fill without touching the density texture

inputs.name: bEnableArtPass
inputs.note: off by default: the art pass is a manual pass, never something a placed room triggers

children.name: RoomShell
children.owns: the shell, the openings, the bead swags, the chair rail, the skirting, the floor medallion, the acoustic tuning
children.never_does: place a prop or an interactable

children.name: DressingSurfaces
children.owns: the named dressing surfaces of this room - shelf tops, table tops, console tops - and the room's interior bounds
children.never_does: decide which prop, or how many

children.name: FillVolume
children.owns: where the fill may spawn at all
children.never_does: place anything that must contact a surface

children.name: CarrierSlot
children.type: a FIXED CHILD actor - the gameplay carrier for this room's beat
children.owns: the beat's interactable: its transform, its mesh, its narrative notification
children.never_does: move after the room is placed; the kit never re-places it
children.note: Jev's decision. The kit proposes; the artist can replace the child in the level without changing the kit.

frozen_metrics.rule: these are FIXED once a layout exists. Changing a pivot, a footprint or a transition metric breaks every room that used the kit (case study BS-04: 'it's generally bad news to change certain aspects of a kit once levels are built with it').
frozen_metrics.pivot: the floor centre of the room's origin bay, z = 0
frozen_metrics.footprint: an integer number of bays: the room's shell is aligned to the 2.4 m bay grid, so two rooms of the same type occupy the same footprint
frozen_metrics.transition: ONE standard portal per room type, on the bay grid: a 2.4 m opening aligned to the module, at a fixed offset from the pivot. Every room type shares the portal logic, so a bedroom and a salon can be joined without bespoke geometry
frozen_metrics.modification_policy: a change to any of these is a NEW kit version, not an edit; the old version stays for the rooms already built with it

placement_rules: placing a room MAY add actors (shell, surfaces, fill, carrier) and MAY NOT move, replace or delete a hand-placed actor
the fill is additive: a re-run adds, it never moves a contract placement
the carrier child may be REPLACED in the level by the artist; the kit never re-places it
two instances of the same room type and seed produce the same shell metrics and the same fill points - the difference between them is the artist's own work

checklist: one HoudiniAssetActor with the room's parameters set
one PCGEx subgraph exposing the room's named surfaces and its interior bounds
one PCGVolume with the room's PCGDensityData (the derived texture)
one carrier child, tagged with the beat it serves (M01/M02/M03/M04/M05)
one entry in the house's dressing census with layer = 'kit'
what_placing_a_room_produces.census_rule: the kit's actors are recorded as layer 'kit' so the census can tell a placed room from hand-placed dressing

verification: two instances of the same type in one level produce identical pivots, footprints and portal offsets
a re-run of the fill adds and never moves: the dressing census is byte-identical before and after
the carrier child is the actor the beat needs, and the beat still fires its narrative notification
the room's fill respects the route exclusion: nothing spawns on the walk corridor
not_yet_true: the Blueprint does not exist - this is a contract for it
the kit has never been placed in an editor
the standard portal has never been drawn between two room types
